name: Hugging Face Datasets API
description: Several hundred thousand published datasets with a uniform API: list and filter them, then read rows, splits, column types and summary statistics through the datasets-server without downloading anything. Effectively a machine-learning-shaped index of open data, including a great deal of scraped, derived and annotated material that exists nowhere else.

license.name: per-dataset; the hub records each one's declared licence
license.redistribution: read the dataset card - a lot of hub data is scraped and its licence is aspirational

access.auth_note: public datasets need no token; gated ones need a free account token
access.rate_limit: unpublished; the datasets-server is the polite way to sample rows
access.pagination: limit and offset on /api/datasets; offset and length on /rows

probes.description: Read rows without downloading the dataset

recipes.title: Peek at a dataset's schema before downloading gigabytes

gotchas.trap: A declared licence on the hub is whatever the uploader typed. Plenty of 'MIT' datasets are scraped from sources that never granted it.
gotchas.fix: For anything you will publish, trace the dataset card back to the original source.

gotchas.trap: The datasets-server only serves datasets it has converted to parquet, so some large or gated ones return an error rather than rows.
